UNVERIFIED: Real deployed binary/compiler/OS and authenticated upstream provenance.
GitHub action implementation, org/repository token defaults, branch protections, runner isolation, release signing and actual published image provenance.
Production network egress/TLS interception/OS symlink policy; cross-user exploitation not demonstrated.
Complete historical secret detection, credential validity/revocation and cloud secret stores.
Remediated release behavior; proposed fixes are not applied or closure-tested.
FILES_NEEDED: Exact deployed binary with checksum, compiler/build manifest and OS details.
Pinned/reviewed third-party action source or immutable action SHAs; repository/organization permissions and branch protection configuration.
A sample successful release run and associated commit/tag/image digest, plus Docker build logs.
Runtime filesystem umask, temp-directory ownership/mount policy and protected_symlinks settings.
Patched dependency versions and source changes for closure testing; no production secrets should be sent.
HARDENING_NOTES: Run the tool/container as an unprivileged identity with a private temp directory.
Document output as untrusted DNS data; use JSON for downstream structured handling.
Keep automatic update checks disabled in strictly controlled audit runs until TLS validation is repaired.
Define explicit input-size/scan-duration/resource budgets if exposed through a service wrapper.
Use verified release provenance and retained logs when results support compliance/audit decisions.
